PERF-301.note: User-accepted stop on 2026-10-16 under the verified conditions; no further optimization scheduled. PERF-301/#241 at e8df73f plus preserved WIP: one authorized preventive single-pass experiment implemented/measured, then rejected and reverted. Rotated valid-crop synthetic CPU -22 to -48%; real crop/OCR-input pixel parity 7/8, changed OCR line list on one image. Key parsed fields unchanged, existing accuracy baseline still red (total 7/8, date 8/8, exact merchant 3/8). Exact pre-experiment camera restored; final 122 functions/148 executions pass, zero skips, including restored 8/8 crop/OCR pixel parity. No production optimization retained. Device runs 3/4 and coarse VM maxima remain historical pre-rotation-fix evidence, not post-change performance or true peak/footprint. Rotation #243/#242 integrated via main sync; other accepted stops and PERF-303 deferral preserved. Stop this rendering attempt; a further approach requires a separate bounded decision.

acceptance.source: Explicit conversation acceptance, followed by request to record it in issue #241 and the audit
verified_conditions: Historical user-operated PFT TEST captures on iPhone 14 Pro Max / iOS 27.0.1: full, distant, partial, rotated and dim; no reported noticeable slowdown or OCR errors. Pre-rotation-fix runs 3/4 measure about 222-252 ms synchronous main-thread crop wall time.
Updated e8df73f plus preserved WIP; Release-TEST, ENABLE_TESTABILITY, en_US / Europe/Rome; iPhone 17 Simulator / iOS 27.0: final 122 regression functions / 148 executions passed, zero failures/skips.
Restored crop and prepared OCR input pixels match on 8/8 photos of one receipt. Separate actual OCR replay preserves full recognized lines and parsed fields versus baseline on 8/8.
acceptance.rejection_reason: Single-pass candidate reduces synthetic rotated valid-crop CPU by 22-48%, but changes real crop/OCR-input pixels and recognized lines on 1/8 photos. Key parsed fields remain unchanged; preservation gate failed, exact pre-experiment camera source restored.
acceptance.known_correctness_limit: Strict OCR accuracy replay remains red with six existing assertions: total correct 7/8, date 8/8, exact merchant 3/8; separate from performance acceptance.

Single device run is not a repeated distribution or comparable before/after; sampled CPU weights are not freeze durations.

Bulk edit/Undo batch validated with Debug Simulator count/wall comparisons and real disk persistence, excluding AppShell fan-out and UI frames. Physical bulk responsiveness, concurrent writers, restore/recurrence, memory, energy, camera/OCR and iPad performance remain unmeasured.
